purpose: Redrawn low-contrast scenery and independent playable platforms

assets.name: moon-quiet-v2
assets.prompt: Production background-only art for a competitive 2D side-view platform duel game. Ultrawide panorama, approximately 2304 by 680, 3.4:1 aspect ratio. A COMPLETELY NEW restrained art direction: elegant softly painted broad shapes, matte surfaces, very low local contrast, muted low-saturation colors, compressed middle-dark value range. Visual hierarchy must reserve ALL strongest contrast, brightest colors, sharpest edges and attention for characters and spells later composited by the game. Environment must recede quietly. Use large calm areas of negative space across the entire playable middle and lower 80 percent of the image. Only 2 or 3 far background depth layers, indistinct softened silhouettes in atmospheric haze, no busy microtexture, no sharp masonry, no heavy black outlines, no bloom, no bright white highlights, no sparkling details, no bright lamps or white flowers. No people no creatures no characters no UI no lettering no border no playable platforms no ground in foreground. Opaque background, do not simulate transparency or fade an old image. This must be thoughtfully redrawn environment art with simplified architecture and new low-frequency composition. Moonlit ruined courtyard atmosphere. Palette desaturated blue slate, dusty ink blue and muted blue grey, roughly #263541 #30424f #3c4b57. A small very dim moon behind thin mist near the upper right, low-contrast far castle silhouettes limited to top third and far sides. One or two broad ruined arch silhouettes quietly framing the extreme outer edges, absolutely no ornate columns running through the arena center. Soft still haze across central open space, broad empty readable arena behind later characters. No saturated cobalt, no gold ornamentation, no waterfalls, no candles, no banners, no star field. Subtle beauty through spacing and soft painted shapes.

assets.name: terrain-quiet-v2
assets.prompt: Production 2D side view platform game terrain sprite atlas, FOUR completely separated thin horizontal platform slabs in a clean 2 by 2 grid, generous truly transparent gutters. New understated softly hand painted art direction, matte low-saturation mid-dark colors, very simple readable silhouettes, broad quiet surface shading. Each slab is about 7 times wider than tall, a clear completely straight flat walkable top, subtly broken underside, modest 3D front face but strict side view, full object visible. TOP LEFT: slate blue grey stone platform, subdued #43535e and #5c6b73. TOP RIGHT: muted plum grey basalt platform, subdued #4b444d and #655961. BOTTOM LEFT: grey sage stone platform with very sparse dull moss on its edge, #465a52 and #65766a. BOTTOM RIGHT: dull weathered grey brown wooden bridge deck with four or five broad planks, #59524b and #70685c. No fine brickwork, no decorative carving, no gold, no flowers, no hanging vines, no lanterns, no arches, no glowing highlights, no ultra sharp high contrast edges, no busy texture, no text no UI no checkerboard. Main characters should always attract more attention than these quiet platforms.
